title: Cold-boot deep link to VacancyDetail silently drops the leaderboard response - boot fetch sites never set leaderboard_vacancy_id, so the new match guard falls through to the no-op arm
detail: modem.init does not fire BrowserChangedUrl at boot (comment in init), so the tag-setting transitions never run. On a fresh page load of /vacancies/:id (real: ApiReturnedSession branch; demo: enter_demo/demo_entry_effects, which set vacancy_detail_request_id but not leaderboard_vacancy_id), the fetch is dispatched with tag None; the Ok response fails the Some(current) guard and is dropped by the fallthrough. Board stays NotAsked forever - a bookmarked vacancy link renders an empty leaderboard.
recommended_fix: Set leaderboard_vacancy_id: Some(id) (and leaderboard: Loading) in the ApiReturnedSession VacancyDetail model update and in enter_demo's deep-link model (mirroring vacancy_detail_request_id), alongside the boot fetches.

title: ApiReturnedLeaderboard Error arm ignores the vacancy-id guard - a late error from vacancy A clobbers vacancy B's board with Failure
evidence:
case result, model.leaderboard_vacancy_id {
        Ok(response), Some(current) if current == vacancy_id -> #(
          ...
        Error(err), _ -> #(
          Model(
            ..model,
            leaderboard: Failure(error_page_copy(
              err,
              copy.CtxApplicationsLoadList,
            )),
          ),
          effect.none(),
        )
        _, _ -> #(model, effect.none())
detail: The Ok path is guarded but Error matches any tag. Sequence: VacancyDetail(A) fetch in flight -> navigate to B (tag B) -> B's Ok lands (Success) -> A's request errors late -> B's board flips to Failure with A's error copy and stays failed until the next refetch. The mismatched error should hit the drop arm like a mismatched Ok.
recommended_fix: Reorder/narrow the arms so Error applies only when the tag matches (Error(err), Some(current) if current == vacancy_id), letting mismatched errors fall through to the no-op arm.

title: vacancy_detail pb-28 compare-bar padding still untested (still present since round 2)
detail: The r3 diff adds a pb-28 pin for application_detail only; a revert of vacancy_detail's conditional padding would go uncaught. Verified by grep: no vacancy_detail pb-28 test exists.
recommended_fix: Add a vacancy_detail view test asserting pb-28 is present when comparison_ids is non-empty and absent when empty.
